newsitem.title: USA: A.M. BEST UPGRADES ACE LTD'S RATING TO A PLUS.
newsitem.headline: A.M. BEST UPGRADES ACE LTD'S RATING TO A PLUS.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Wednesday it has upgraded ACE Ltd and its group members to A-plus (Superior) from A (Excellent), effective immediately.

A.M. Best said the A-plus rating reflects the group's strong market position as a lead provider of large program limits to Fortune 1000 companies, global market position and product diversity. It also reflects the group's strong management team, superior underwriting results and strong balance sheet, A.M. Best said.
AM Best said that over the past five years, the group has averaged an annual premium growth rate of 19.6 percent and retained 90.0 percent of its insureds.
In 1996, it generated superior underwriting results with a combined ratio of 94.8 percent, it said.
The group had a strong balance sheet with $2.2 billion in shareholder's equity supporting $602.7 million in premium writings, and $1.8 billion in reserves as of September 30, 1996, the company said.
